fields.summary: TC-762-01: Pay Audit Lambda Uses Actual Flight Departure and Arrival Times When Available

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-762

Precondition: A trip has completed with both scheduled and actual flight times available. The Pay Audit Lambda must use actual flight times (blockOut, blockIn, actualDepartureDateTimeUTC, actualArrivalDateTimeUTC) when performing the audit comparison rather than scheduled times.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a completed trip where actual flight times differ from scheduled times by more than 30 minutes
Leg: DAL->HOU. Scheduled dep=08:00Z, Scheduled arr=09:15Z. Actual dep=08:35Z, Actual arr=10:05Z (50 min delay)
Trip record is available in DynamoDB with both scheduled and actual times populated
Trigger the Pay Audit Lambda for the completed trip
Pay Audit Lambda invoked with trip record containing both scheduled and actual times
Pay Audit Lambda is invoked successfully
Verify the Lambda selects actualArrivalDateTimeUTC and actualDepartureDateTimeUTC (not scheduled) for the pay calculation
Lambda input: scheduledArrival=09:15Z, actualArrival=10:05Z. Lambda must use 10:05Z
Lambda uses actual flight times (10:05Z arrival) for the pay audit comparison - scheduled times are not used
Verify the pay audit result reflects the difference calculated using actual times
Actual arr=10:05Z vs scheduled arr=09:15Z: 50 min delay used in audit comparison
Audit result captures the 50 min actual delay based on actual times - not the scheduled time difference
Verify the audit result stored in DynamoDB uses actual-time-based calculation and is reflected correctly in the COA Search App
DynamoDB audit record and COA Search App after audit completion
DynamoDB and COA Search App show audit values based on actual flight times, not scheduled times
